steps.task: Prove strict semantic lock conservation and validate the root dependency environment.
requirements: pyproject.toml must differ from current main only at the aiohttp floor.
Candidate lock must resolve aiohttp 3.14.3.
After removing aiohttp package records and normalizing aiohttp requires-dist specifier values, parsed base and candidate lock structures must be identical.
uv lock --check and uv sync --frozen must pass.
Run focused tests that reference aiohttp, then the relevant complete root suite once.
If the complete suite fails, compare with current-main baseline before attribution.
commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
import tomllib,copy,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base=tomllib.loads(subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/main:uv.lock'],text=True))
cand=tomllib.loads(Path('uv.lock').read_text())
def normalize(d):
    d=copy.deepcopy(d)
    d['package']=[p for p in d.get('package',[]) if p.get('name')!='aiohttp']
    for p in d.get('package',[]):
        md=p.get('metadata') or {}
        for item in md.get('requires-dist',[]) or []:
            if item.get('name')=='aiohttp': item['specifier']='<AIOHTTP_SPEC>'
    return d
if normalize(base)!=normalize(cand): raise SystemExit('UNRELATED_LOCK_CHURN')
rows=[p for p in cand.get('package',[]) if p.get('name')=='aiohttp']
assert rows and all(p.get('version')=='3.14.3' for p in rows)
print('LOCK_CONSERVATION=PASS')
PY

python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
base=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','origin/main:pyproject.toml'],text=True).splitlines()
cand=Path('pyproject.toml').read_text().splitlines()
def norm(xs): return [('<AIOHTTP>' if 'aiohttp' in x else x) for x in xs]
assert norm(base)==norm(cand)
assert any('aiohttp>=3.14.3' in x for x in cand)
print('PYPROJECT_SCOPE=PASS')
PY
